sections.preamble: You are an expert coding assistant operating inside pi, a coding agent harness. You help users by reading files, executing commands, editing code, and writing new files.
sections.tools:
<tools>
- read: Read file contents
- bash: Execute bash commands (ls, grep, find, etc.)
- edit: Make precise file edits with exact text replacement, including multiple disjoint edits in one call
- write: Create or overwrite files

In addition to the tools above, you may have access to other custom tools depending on the project.
</tools>
sections.rules:
<rules>
- Use bash for file operations like ls, rg, find
- Use read to examine files instead of cat or sed.
- You can inspect PI_* environment variables for current model and session details.
- Use edit for precise changes (edits[].oldText must match exactly)
- When changing multiple separate locations in one file, use one edit call with multiple entries in edits[] instead of multiple edit calls
- Each edits[].oldText is matched against the original file, not after earlier edits are applied. Do not emit overlapping or nested edits. Merge nearby changes into one edit.
- Keep edits[].oldText as small as possible while still being unique in the file. Do not pad with large unchanged regions.
- Use write only for new files or complete rewrites.
- Be concise in your responses
- Show file paths clearly when working with files
</rules>

For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

toolsAdded.name: bash
toolsAdded.description: Execute a bash command in the current working directory. Returns stdout and stderr. Output is truncated to last 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). If truncated, full output is saved to a temp file. Optionally provide a timeout in seconds.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds (optional, no default timeout)

toolsAdded.name: edit
toolsAdded.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

toolsAdded.name: write
toolsAdded.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

Create an SVG logo for a generative AI company using organic shapes and neutral tones

Deliver the result as image and/or video files, working in the current directory.
- Save the finished files in ./output/. Only what is in ./output/ is published as the result, so
  ./output/ holds those finished image/video files and nothing else.
- Formats: images as .png, .jpg, .webp, .gif or .svg; videos as .mp4 or .webm. At most 8 files,
  each under 2 MB; videos at most 10 seconds.
- Tools available on this machine: python3 3.15.0 (standard library only), node 26.12.0 (no npm packages), ffmpeg 9.0.2, ffprobe 9.0.2. Don't install packages or download anything.
- Keep the code you write to make the files in the working directory (its root, or a subdirectory
  like ./src/, but not in ./output/): it's published as the source. Delete intermediate files such
  as rendered frames when you're done.
- Only create or edit files inside the current directory.
- Finish with a short summary of what you made.

I need to deliver a brand sheet with a subtle, off-white background and an effective logo lockup. The design should feature three organic lobes with a distinct arrangement, and I want to ensure it looks sophisticated without being distracting. I'll focus on neutral tones like graphite and warm taupe for a modern touch.

An interesting idea is an organic monogram for "loam" with asymmetrical pebble rings or a flowing contour resembling a fingerprint. I could use three soft overlapping lobes with subtle gradients and a neutral, scalable color palette including taupe and graphite. For the wordmark, I’ll go with lowercase custom outlines.

"""Generate Loam's original, fully outlined SVG identity. No dependencies."""
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUT = ROOT / 'output'
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
INK = '#353A33'
PAPER = '#F3F0E8'

# Three gently curled seed husks. Their inward tips leave an open, living center.
PETAL = '''M 8,-9
C 42,-22 78,-52 79,-95
C 80,-139 47,-169 8,-167
C -36,-165 -68,-134 -67,-94
C -67,-54 -44,-35 -18,-22
C -8,-17 -4,-11 -4,-2
C 0,-5 4,-7 8,-9 Z'''

# Bespoke lowercase lettering: soft bowls, a low shoulder, and a curled l.
LETTERS = [
    '''M 12,0 C 5,0 0,5 0,12 L 0,151
    C 0,173 12,184 34,184 L 49,184 L 49,159 L 40,159
    C 31,159 27,154 27,145 L 27,12 C 27,5 22,0 15,0 Z''',
    '''M 126,53 C 89,53 65,78 65,118 C 65,158 88,184 125,184
    C 164,184 188,157 188,117 C 188,78 165,53 126,53 Z
    M 125,78 C 147,78 161,93 161,118 C 161,144 148,159 125,159
    C 103,159 92,144 92,118 C 92,93 104,78 125,78 Z''',
    '''M 269,53 C 230,53 207,78 207,118 C 207,158 229,184 264,184
    C 285,184 300,174 307,161 L 307,180 L 332,180 L 332,57 L 307,57
    L 307,73 C 298,60 284,53 269,53 Z
    M 270,78 C 294,78 307,93 307,118 C 307,143 293,159 270,159
    C 247,159 234,142 234,118 C 234,93 247,78 270,78 Z''',
    '''M 359,57 L 384,57 L 384,73 C 393,60 406,53 423,53
    C 443,53 457,63 464,79 C 475,61 489,53 508,53
    C 541,53 558,74 558,108 L 558,180 L 531,180 L 531,111
    C 531,89 522,78 505,78 C 487,78 476,93 476,115 L 476,180
    L 449,180 L 449,111 C 449,89 440,78 423,78
    C 404,78 386,94 386,116 L 386,180 L 359,180 Z'''
]

# Small uppercase architectural lettering, also paths rather than font references.
GLYPHS = {
    'G': 'M 10,2 C 8,0 2,0 1,5 L 1,9 C 1,14 7,15 10,12 L 10,8 L 6,8',
    'E': 'M 10,1 L 1,1 L 1,14 L 10,14 M 1,7.5 L 8,7.5',
    'N': 'M 1,14 L 1,1 L 10,14 L 10,1',
    'R': 'M 1,14 L 1,1 L 6,1 C 12,1 12,7.5 6,7.5 L 1,7.5 M 6,7.5 L 11,14',
    'A': 'M 0,14 L 5.5,1 L 11,14 M 2.3,9 L 8.7,9',
    'T': 'M 0,1 L 11,1 M 5.5,1 L 5.5,14',
    'I': 'M 5.5,1 L 5.5,14',
    'V': 'M 0,1 L 5.5,14 L 11,1',
    'L': 'M 1,1 L 1,14 L 10,14',
    'C': 'M 10,2.5 C 7,-0.5 1,0 1,6 L 1,9 C 1,15 7,15 10,12.5',
}

def symbol(x=0, y=0, scale=1):
    paths = '\n'.join(f'<path d="{PETAL}" fill="{color}" transform="rotate({angle})"/>'
                      for angle, color in [(0, '#858673'), (120, '#B2A38E'), (240, '#575E50')])
    return f'<g transform="translate({x} {y}) scale({scale})">{paths}</g>'

def wordmark(x, y, scale=1):
    paths = ''.join(f'<path d="{p}"/>' for p in LETTERS)
    return f'<g fill="{INK}" fill-rule="evenodd" transform="translate({x} {y}) scale({scale})">{paths}</g>'

def descriptor(x, y, scale=1):
    offset = 0
    paths = []
    for char in 'GENERATIVE INTELLIGENCE':
        if char == ' ':
            offset += 13
        else:
            paths.append(f'<path transform="translate({offset} 0)" d="{GLYPHS[char]}"/>')
            offset += 18
    return f'<g transform="translate({x} {y}) scale({scale})" fill="none" stroke="{INK}" stroke-width="1.18" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round">{"".join(paths)}</g>'

def svg(width, height, content, label):
    return f'''<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="{width}" height="{height}" viewBox="0 0 {width} {height}" role="img" aria-labelledby="title desc">
<title id="title">{label}</title>
<desc id="desc">Loam, generative intelligence. Three organic seed forms unfold around an open center, paired with a custom lowercase wordmark. Warm stone, muted olive-grey and charcoal.</desc>
{content}
</svg>\n'''

# Spacious presentation artboard.
presentation = f'<rect width="1600" height="1000" fill="{PAPER}"/>'
presentation += symbol(421, 494, 1.03)
presentation += wordmark(649, 377, 1.14)
presentation += descriptor(653, 628, 1.04)
(OUT / 'loam-logo.svg').write_text(svg(1600, 1000, presentation, 'Loam — generative intelligence'))

# Transparent production assets; the wordmark is completely outlined.
lockup = symbol(177, 190, 0.92) + wordmark(384, 88, 1.05) + descriptor(388, 319, 0.96)
(OUT / 'loam-lockup.svg').write_text(svg(1010, 380, lockup, 'Loam — transparent logo lockup'))
(OUT / 'loam-symbol.svg').write_text(svg(400, 400, symbol(200, 200, 1.02), 'Loam — organic seed symbol'))
print('Created 3 SVG assets in output/')

#!/bin/bash
# Rebuild vector assets and the PNG presentation using the installed Chrome.
set -euo pipefail
ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
python3 "$ROOT/src/create_logo.py"
TEMP="$(mktemp -d "$ROOT/.render.XXXXXX")"
trap 'rm -rf "$TEMP"' EXIT
"/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" \
  --headless --disable-gpu --no-first-run --no-default-browser-check \
  --user-data-dir="$TEMP/chrome" --hide-scrollbars \
  --window-size=1600,1000 --screenshot="$ROOT/output/loam-logo.png" \
  "file://$ROOT/output/loam-logo.svg" >/dev/null 2>&1
